tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi: bka' srung mgon po'i phrin las bzhugs so:

bla ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: bka' srung kun gyi mthar thug pa: ma hā kā la'i phrin las bshad: de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi: dang po rang nyid lha ru bsgom: mchod pa thams cad byin gyis brlab: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni: mdun du khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong: ma la ya yi ri bo'i do: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i brag steng du: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba la: pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ yig las: gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal: de las rdo rje srin po'i sku: ma hā kā la legs ldan ni: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rkan sgra rdeb: spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: smin ma kham nag skar chen 'phro: ral pa mun chen ltar gtibs shing: phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba dang: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin: mchan du tsan+dan bing chen brten: lha dmag bdud dmag pho nyar 'gyed: dar nag ber chen brtsegs mar gsol: dbu rgyan thod skam rin chen sogs: dur khrod chas kyis legs par brgyan: sag l+h+wam gsol zhing 'dor stabs bzhengs: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong: g.yon du kaṃ las yum mchog ni: kro dhī shwa rī thal ba'i mdog: ral pa rting sleb sbrul zhags dang: thod pa khrag bkang g.yon pas rol: re lde'i sham thabs dur khrod chas: yab la 'dun pa'i tshul du gnas: g.yas su hūm̐ las las mgon nag: gri gug dang ni thod khrag 'dzin: mi sdug gzugs can ber nag gsol: shar du hūm̐ las king ka ra: mthing nag dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thod khrag 'dzin: gri thogs ging chen rnams kyis bskor: lho ru ya las gnod sbyin dmar: bse rmog bse khrab sku la gsol: gser gyi ral gri gser mdung bsnams: srin mo bse gdong spu gri 'dzin: bse yi skyes bu bu mo dang: mi dmar shan pa'i tshogs kyis bskor: nub tu dzaḥlas gza' bdud smug:

mgo dgu bya rog zhal dang bcu: g.yas pas gri gug skyin thang 'beb: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin: chu srin zhags 'phen sbrul mjug can: gza' skar gdong mo'i tshogs kyis bskor: byang du ma las 'dod khams ma: nag mo gtum la sgeg pa'i tshul: zhal du mi ro rengs pa gsol: snyan la seng ge sbrul gyis brgyan: khram shing dang ni nad rkyal 'dzin: rma bya'i zur phud mi lpags gsol: lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char: zhabs gnyis btsan skyil rol pa'i stabs: drel rta rkang gsum steng du bzhugs: nag mo 'bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor: khrag mtsho rlung 'tshubs dbus su bzhugs: sde dpon sum cu bka' la nyan: dregs chen bco brgyad las la 'gyed: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig las: 'od 'phros 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: badz+ra sa mā dza: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams dang: ko ka thang dmar rgya mtsho'i do: drag shul can gyi ri bo nas: tshogs rje tshogs bdag nag po che: ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol: las kyi mgon po gshegs su gsol: kro tī shwa rī gshegs su gsol: sgrol ging nag po gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol: gza' bdud chen po gshegs su gsol: 'dod khams bdag mo gshegs su gsol: dregs pa sde brgyad gshegs su gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gha ṇa pa ti sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sngon tshe he ru ka dpal gyis: bdud kyi sde rnams btul ba'i tshe: ma hā kā la tshogs kyi bdag: nyer gnas kro dhī shwa rī ma: slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs: dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dpal gyi 'bangs su zhal 'ches nas: bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas ltar: dam tshig gnyan dgongs phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa:

hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: gtum po mi bzad drag shul can: dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid che: 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na mā mi: hūm̐: khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral pa yi: khrag chen ar+ghaṃ chu bo 'bab: dug khrag zhabs bsil mtsho ltar bskyil: dbang po'i me tog nam mkha' gang: tshil chen gsur dud mun ltar gtibs: zhun chen sgron me bskal me sbar: dri chen byug pa rba klong 'khrug: thod rnga rkang gling 'brug ltar sgrog: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi mchod sprin bzhin: dam can rgya mtsho rnams la 'bul: hūm̐: 'bru sna'i tshogs dang dkar mngar dang: myos byed la du shing tog dang: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim pa: ro mngar reg bya 'jam po'i tshogs: lha yi 'dun sa bzhin du mchod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa pū dza ho: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba yi: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: chags chen rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs: ma hā kā la'i tshogs la 'bul: bza' bca' btung ba bsam mi khyab: 'dod yon gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med bde chen sbyor ba yi: byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dus mchod: mkha' dbyings e yi brub khung du: ma rig gnyis 'dzin bdud dang bgegs: rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon gyis bsgral: phung po sha khrag rus pas mchod: ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin ru dra'i rgyu: rtogs na thams cad lha yi ngang: dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas che: ye mchod chen por bzhes su gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri bā ra pañtsa a mṛta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ bhu ru ku ru i tsi ki byi u tsuṣ+ma ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: kro dhī shwa rī i daṃ ba liṃ ta= pañtsa a mṛta= ma hā rak+ta= oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta=

oṃ ma hā kro dha king ka ra sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta= oṃ ma hā yak+sha tsit+ta hring hring sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta= oṃ rā hu la pak+sha me ki sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta= oṃ traka rak+sha yak+sha bai tā li sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta= sarba duṣ+ṭān sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ= pañtsa a= ma hā rak+ta= dgra bgegs che ge nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: oṃ ma hā kā la dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta= ma hā tsit+ta= ma hā go ro tsa na= ma hā ba su ta= kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā su kha pū dza ho: dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hūm̐: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: thabs kyi cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: dpal mgon legs ldan nag po tshogs kyi bdag: bstan srung chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: dngos grub thogs med stsol la phyag= phrin las myur du sgrub la phyag= sgrib med mngon shes ldan la phyag= ston pas lung bstan thob la phyag 'tshal bstod: sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams dang dgongs pa gcig: rig 'dzin grub thob rnams dang byin rlabs gcig: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig: dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs dang mthu rtsal gcig: sngon gyi drang srong rnams dang smon lam gcig: ma hā kā la khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: las la chas pa'i sras mchog nag po ni: mthu rtsal rab ldan gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: ber chen gsol nas lha yi dmag dpung sdud: gtum po nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug kro tī shwa rī ma: ma rungs 'ching mdzad sbrul gyi zhags pa dang: thod pa khrag chang mar khus bkang ba gsol: gsang ba'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang sgrol ging gnod sbyin rā hu la: 'dod khams bdag mo sde dpon sngags bdag sogs:

dpal chen he ru ka yi bka' nyan pa: tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las mdzad la bstod: ces bstod cing phrin las gsol ba ni: ho: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos shing: longs spyod rdzogs sku he ru ka dpal ma hā kā la'i skur bzhengs pa: sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung chen po: rnal 'byor gyi dgra bla chen po: gsang sngags bka'i srung ma: dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma: 'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso bo: legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po: las mgon sras mchog nag po: yum kro dhī shwa rī ma: khro chen king ka ra: gnod sbyin dmar po: gza' mchog rā hu la: lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang mo re ma ti: 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod do: bstod do: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: bla ma'i sku tshe srings: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang: yid la 'dod pa thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang: dam nyams dgra bgegs log par spyod cing bar chad kyi rkyen byed pa thams cad thal ba rdul bzhin du mdzod cig: gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la: tshogs dang bshags pa skong ba bya: rten la bstim mam rang gnas gshegs: bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi bka' srung legs ldan gyi rtags bstod bzhugs so: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las khro bo'i skur ston pa: stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i brda: rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu brgyan pa: bde gshegs rigs lngas dbang bskur mdzad pa'i rtags: dbu skra ral pa gyen du sprin ltar gtibs: lta ba rnam dag mtha' ru phyin pa'i rtags: spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rnams rdzogs pa'i rtags: shangs gnyer hūm̐ hūm̐ 'thor rlung 'phyo ba ni: dngos 'dzin rnam rtog thams cad gtor ba'i rtags:

snyan nas sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrog pa ni: chos rnams ma lus thugs su chud pa'i rtags: sma ra smin ma kham nag skar chen 'phro: khro bo kun gyi mthu stobs rdzogs pa'i rtags: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb pa ni: chos kyi gsung ldan sems can sgrol ba'i rtags: zla tshes lta bu'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: mtha' bzhir 'dzin pa'i log rtog bcom pa'i rtags: dpal gyi gtum rngam srin po khros pa'i zhal: chos rnams ro gcig sna tshogs snang ba'i rtags: phyag gnyis zhabs zung gar gyi stangs stabs ni: tshad med bzhi yis bdud bzhi bcom pa'i rtags: sku stod seng ge rab tu 'gying 'dra ba: mi 'jigs bzhi yi yon tan rdzogs pa'i rtags: rked pa gzhu yi changs zung ltar 'dril ba: dbang bcu mnga' ba thogs med phrin las rtags: gsang ba rdo rje nor bu 'bar ba ni: ye sbyor ye sgrol 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags: zhabs g.yas bskums pas khams gsum dbang du sdud: zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas srid gsum zil gnon rtags: sa gsum dbang sgyur ber chen sum brtsegs gsol: rin chen ska rags dgos 'dod stsol ba'i rtags: g.yas pas gri gug skye shi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas thod khrag 'khor ba stongs pa'i rtags: beng chen phur bus dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral: sprul pa'i dmag 'gyed bdud kyi g.yul zlog rtags: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol pa ni: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i rtags: ye shes me phung klong du bzhugs pa ni: ma rig bag chags rnam rtog sreg pa'i rtags: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni: che ba'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa'i rtags: g.yas g.yon gnyis las seng ge 'phyo ba ni: 'jigs byed chen po las la 'gyed pa'i rtags: sta zur gnyis nas 'phar dred rgyug pa ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs srog la rngams mdzad rtags: zhabs gnyis brdabs pas stag mo 'phro ba ni: phra men mang po las la 'gyed pa'i rtags:

sangs rgyas bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba: ye shes mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: de yi yum chen kro dhī shwa rī ma: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rtags: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal skya lta bu'i mdog: skye med chos rnams thugs su chud pa'i rtags: phyag g.yas sbrul zhags nam mkhar g.yug pa ni: nyon mongs dngos med rang grol mkhyen pa'i rtags: g.yon pas mar khu khrag chang gsol pa ni: dug gsum 'joms shing dngos grub stsol ba'i rtags: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa ni: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gtso mo mdzad pa'i rtags: re lde'i sham thabs sku la gsol ba ni: ye shes 'jig rten ma mo dbang sdud rtags: sbyor sgrol mdzad phyir yab la 'dun pa'i tshul: bde chen ye shes ngang du rol pa'i rtags: dbyings kyi yum mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gtum chen mi bzad sras mchog nag po ni: sku mdog mthing nag char sprin 'khrugs pa 'dra: mi 'gyur rnam dag ye shes mnga' ba'i rtags: gri gug phyar zhing thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing dngos grub stsol ba'i rtags: ber chen phyi nang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: pho rgyud mo rgyud dbang du sdud pa'i rtags: mi'u thung gel pa'i gzugs can 'dor stabs bzhengs: dam can yongs kyi gtso bo khyod la bstod: hūm̐: bka' sdod chen po khro chen king ka ra: mthing nag mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thun khrag 'phen: dur khrod chas can sgrol ging bcu gnyis 'gyed: nyams pa thams cad thabs kyis bsgral ba'i rtags: sangs rgyas bstan srung khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gnod sbyin dmar po rab khros khrag gi mdog: bse khrab bse rmog dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gser gyi spu gri gser mdung dmar ser rdeb: srin mo bswe gdong gser gyi spu gri 'dzin: bse yi skyes bu bzhi dang bu mo bzhi: mi dmar shan pa bzhi bcu las la 'gyed:

gsang sngags bka' yi bya ra mdzad pa'i rtags: bstan srung chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gza' bdud dud kha mgo dgu bya rog zhal: phyag g.yas gri gug rtse nas skyin thang 'beb: g.yon pas chu srin zhags 'phen thod khrag rol: spyan stong ldan zhing sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil: gza' brgyad rgyu skar gdong mo pho nyar 'gyed: sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad pa'i rtags: dregs pa yongs kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang shar mu le khrag mtsho rlung nag dbus: srid pa'i rgyal mo dpal ldan lha mo ni: rma bya seng ge sbrul gyis dbu la brgyan: mche ba bzhi gtsigs mi ro rengs pa gsol: g.yas pas khram shing dgra bo khram la 'debs: g.yon pas nad rkyal dgra la nad yams 'gyed: mi lpags g.yang gzhi re lda'i sham thabs gsol: drel rta rkang gsum srin po'i sga stan can: 'chib nas stong gsum ma lus yud kyis bskor: mtshon gyi dru bu nad kyi rkyal pa dang: shwa rdil dkar nag bdud kyi khram shing dang: sprul pa'i mtshon cha rnam lnga sha thag mdzad: dkar mo nag mo dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor: nag mo re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu mthu rtsal can: cha lugs phyag mtshan zhon pa sna tshogs can: sngags bdag bco brgyad dmod pa'i mtshon cha can: 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam 'gyur cir yang ston: 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtso bo sde brgyad rnams: dam nyams dgra yi sha dang khrag la dgyes: dam tshig dbang gis sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: bka' sdod rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ces bstod pas lha rnams mnyes shing phrin las thogs med du sgrub par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi bka' srung mgon po'i skong bshags bzhugs so: dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes mgon po'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags pa ni: gdung ba drag pos thal mo sbyar la: hūm̐: ma hā kā la 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i sgor zhugs nas: dam tshig tshul bzhin srung bar khas blangs par: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul byung ba mthol lo bshags: 'khor ba sdug bsngal me 'obs lta bu la: zhen cing chags pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po la: snying nas blo gtad ma bgyis mthol lo= 'gro drug sems can pha mar gyur pa la: snying rjes phan sems chung ba mthol= nyams chag 'gal 'khrul sdig pa'i tshogs rnams la: ma bshags sbas gsang 'chab pa mthol= mchod pa'i zhing du gyur pa'i mgron rigs la: ser snas mchod sbyin ma byas mthol= gsang sngags ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la: dad cing mos pas ma bsten mthol= dkyil 'khor gtso bo dpal ldan bla ma la: snying nas thugs 'gal bgyis pa mthol= gsang sngags sgrub pa'i mched dang lcam dral la: brnyas shing brtse gdung chung ba mthol= lta ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa la: gnyis 'dzin mtha' bzhis bcings pa mthol= yi dam lha yi bskyed rim bsgom pa la: tha mal a 'thas 'khrul pa mthol= gsang sngags bzlas brjod tshul bzhin bgyid rgyu la: chad lhag zur chag nyams pa mthol= bsnyen sgrub thun bzhi'i 'phrang la bcug pa la: don med long gtam g.yengs pa mthol= tshogs dang mchod gtor dus su brtson pa la: le lo sgyid snyom gyur pa mthol= phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad la: 'bag btsog gtsang sme ma phyed mthol= dam rdzas tshul bzhin bsham par khas blangs nas: phud lhag dri mas gos pa mthol= phyi nang gsang rten btsugs par khas blangs nas:

tshul bzhin rdzas ma 'dzoms pa mthol= mthun rdzas spyan gzigs 'bul bar khas blangs nas: yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol= rten dang lta spyod zab mo gsang ba la: gzhan la 'chol par smras pa mthol= man ngag gsang nas sgrub par khas blangs kyang: gzhan la bshad cing ngoms pa mthol= slob dpon bka' dang mched kyis bsgos pa rnams: gzhan la ma gsang bshad pa mthol= dam can rnams kyis mthu nus rtags bstan pa: ma gsang gzhan la ngoms pa mthol= dug lnga ye shes lnga ru ma rtogs par: nyon mongs rang gar spyad pa mthol= sha lnga bdud rtsi dang du ma blangs nas: sbyang spel bsgyur bar ma nus mthol= chos rnams rnam dag lha ru ma rtogs pa: shes bya'i dam las 'gal ba mthol= dam can rgya mtsho rigs lnga'i ngang du gnas: bsgrub bya yin par ma shes mthol= thabs shes sbyor bas bde chen ye shes rtogs: mtshan ldan rig ma spangs pa mthol= lhan skyes ye shes ma rtogs zhen pas bcings: sbyor ba phyin ci log pa mthol= zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs yal bar dor: ngan sngags mthu yis ma bsgral mthol= rang 'dod chags sdang rdzas ngan sbyor bas bsgral: sgrol ba phyin ci log pa mthol= ser sna can gyi zas nor thabs kyis blangs: 'gro don mchod sbyin ma byas mthol= chags zhen sred pas dad pa'i nor blangs nas: dngos po chud zos song ba mthol= rang dang gzhan gyi gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams: rdzun gyis gsang bar ma nus mthol= ma mthong mthong dang ma rtogs rtogs so zhes: mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smras mthol= sdig spyod bya ba ngan pa'i las rtsom la: rtsub pa'i tshig gis ma bzlog mthol= zhi dul chos kyi smra ba mi byed par: tshig rtsub long gtam byas pa mthol= rang gi grub mtha' tshul bzhin mi bzung bar: dam tshig nyams dang 'dres pa mthol= lta spyod sgom sgrub tshul bzhin mi byed par: gsang sngags gzhung dang 'gal ba mthol= de ltar ma rig dbang du song ba yis: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags:

phyin chad bdag gis mi 'gal dam bca' bas: ma hā kā la'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod: dmigs med klong du tshangs pa bstsal nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes yig brgya bzla: ho: ma hā kā la dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sgrub pa po la gsan cing dgongs su gsol: dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: dad pa dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: gsang ba'i rten mchog rnams la bzhugs nas kyang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bag med nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: dam la gnas shing lha la phreng: mchod phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyi yi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang: dug chu khol ma'i zhabs bsil 'bul: dbang po lnga yi me tog dang: tshil chen gsur gyi dud sprin gtibs: zhing chen ro ras spar ba'i me: myos byed gi waṃ byug pa'i bcud: sha rus nang khrol zhal gyi zas: ḍā ma ru dang rkang gling sgra: rnga chen dung chen la sogs pas: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim pa: ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa dang: rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis pa'i: rdzas mchog brgyad dang rtags brgyad dang: bcu drug lha mo'i rol pa yis: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: nang gi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: sha chen lang ling rak+tar bcas: 'bru sna shing tog me tog dang: dkar dmar rjen sha spod kyi rigs: la du khur ba sgog btsong gi: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan bshams: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: gsang ba'i mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: mchog chen yab yum mnyam sbyar ba'i: byang chub sems ni bde ba'i sprin: ru dra dgra bgegs bdud kyi tshogs:

bsgral pa'i sha khrag bsam mi khyab: chos rnams mnyam nyid rtogs pa yis: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: phyi yi rten mchog yin pa'i phyir: zhwa nag gos nag sku 'bag dang: go mtshon phyag mtshan ru mtshon dang: rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi: bya gcan ri dwags rin chen 'bru: dar zab pags pa dkor nor gyis: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir: thod pa mtshan ldan zhing lpags dang: nal bu'i pags pa thod pa dang: dkyil 'khor dam rdzas la sogs pas: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: gsang ba'i rten mchog yin pa'i phyir: gri snying srog 'khor bla rdo dang: nal bu'i snying dang gsang ba'i sku: 'bras bu lnga dang shing lo sogs: srung ma rnams kyi srog sngags kyis: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= snang stong bskyed rim grags stong sngags: mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bzlas brjod dang: rtsa rlung thig le byang chub pa: thabs shes mnyam sbyar dga' bzhi bsgom: ma bcos lta ba'i gnas lugs rtogs: zhen 'dzin med pa'i spyod pa yis: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mthar phyin pas: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= mnan bsreg 'phang gsum sbyor ba yis: bstan pa'i dgra bo bsgral nas kyang: sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba yis: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs= ma hā kā la'i thugs= tshogs rje tshogs bdag thugs= lha chen dpal 'bar thugs= chos skyong chen po'i thugs= sras mchog nag po'i thugs= kro tī shwa rī'i thugs= king ka ra yi thugs= gnod sbyin chen po'i thugs= gza' mchog chen po'i thugs= dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs= ging chen rnams kyi thugs= shan pa rnams kyi thugs= gza' skar gdong mo'i thugs= ma mo'i tshogs kyi thugs= sde dpon sum cu'i thugs= sngags bdag bco brgyad thugs= dregs chen sde brgyad thugs= pho rgyud rnams kyi thugs= mo rgyud rnams kyi thugs= ma ning rnams kyi thugs= 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang:

thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol: ces skong ba la 'bad par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi bka' srung legs ldan nag po'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so: ༁ྃ: dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: zhing ngam gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du tshe gal: māṃ sa: zla rgyas: zla phrom: khur ba: la du sogs bza' btung rnams bsham: rnal 'byor pho mo rnams chas kyis brgyan: bsang chu 'thor zhing: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ye shes me rlung chu yis dngos 'dzin sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las bhañdza 'bar ba'i snod rnams su: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas bdud rtsi lnga: mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las sha lnga gsal: rlung me sbyor bas 'od zhu bdud rtsir 'khyil: rlangs pas ye shes bcud bsdus de la thim: dam ye gnyis med kha dog dri ror ldan: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod sprin spro bar bsam: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas: yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang rang gar bzhugs gnas mchog nas: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: hūm̐: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod sprin 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma: ma mgon lcam dral la sogs pa'i: dam can rgya mtsho rnams la 'bul: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: hūm̐: thog med dus nas bsags pa yi: ma rig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul rnams: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: yig brgya brjod: hūm̐: dug gsum gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: ye shes mtshon gyis bsgral nas su: sha khrag rus pa nang khrol bcas: dam can srung ma'i zhal du bstab: māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: tshogs la longs spyod lhag ma bsdus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhag la dbang ba'i dregs pa ni:

ma mo las byed tshogs dang bcas: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: dur khrod kun nyul sha chen za: zhing lpags gyon nas bhañdza thogs: ral pa gtibs shing bshugs glu len: legs nyes stangs 'dzin phrin las ni: thogs med sgrub pa'i dam can rnams: tshogs lhag bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzad pa dang: phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: lhag ma rnams phyi rol du bskyal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༁ྃ: thugs dam zab pa skor bdun gyi bka' srung legs ldan nag po'i phrin las bcol ba'i rim pa bzhugs so: ༁ྃ: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings yum gyi mkha' klong nas: mgon po chen po khyod 'ong tshe: sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ltar: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ru dra nag po btul ba'i tshe: khro rgyal rnams kyis dbang bskur nas: mthu rtsal rmad du byung ba bzhin: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams su: tshogs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin rnams kyis bka' bsgos ltar: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: chad tho bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: dpal chen yang dag he ru kas: mgon po nag po 'khor bcas la: dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan btags tshe: ji ltar zhal bzhes ma g.yel bar: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: legs ldan nag po'i grong khyer du: bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis: rdo rje gtsug tor rigs lnga yis: dbang bskur dam la bzhag pa bzhin: ji ltar zhal bzhes ma g.yel bar: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: rig 'dzin slob dpon rnam brgyad kyis: bstan pa srung ba'i bka' bsgos bzhin:

ji ltar zhal bzhes ma g.yel bar: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dpal gyi bsam yas gtsug phug tu: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po yis: bka' yi srung mar bskos pa bzhin: ji ltar zhal bzhes ma g.yel bar: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: da lta sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: ma mgon lcam dral khyed rnams la: bsnyen sgrub mchod cing bstod dus su: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: srung ba la sogs pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la khro bo'i rgyal: dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis: lus ngag yid gsum srung ba dang: sbas shing 'jigs pa brgyad las skyobs: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: thos bsam sgom pa 'phel ba dang: bstan 'dzin skyes bu dar bar mdzod: yid la 'dod pa dbang du sdus: sgrub gnas gtsug lag srung ba dang: 'khor dang longs spyod bskyang du gsol: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: nye bar 'tshe ba bsrung du gsol: zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas: ma hā kā la mthu stobs can: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs: ru tra bdud kyi bar chad zlog: spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad pa yis: 'phags pa rnams kyi bka' chad zlog: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil: lha rnams kun gyi bka' chad zlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' chad zlog: snyan nas 'brug ltar gsung sgra sgrog: nang pa chos kyi dmod pa zlog: shangs nas rdo rje'i 'thor rlung 'phyo: phyi pa mu stegs dmod pa zlog: sma ra smin ma skar chen 'phro: gza' skar rnams kyi chad pa zlog: g.yas pas gri gug 'bar ba 'dzin: gshin rje rnams kyi chad pa zlog: g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gsol:

ma mo rnams kyi dmod pa zlog: thod skam rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: rigs lnga'i khrag 'thung bka' chad zlog: dar nag ber chen sku la gsol: mgon po rnams kyi bka' chad zlog: gser ska nor bu rked du bcings: gnod sbyin rnams kyi chad pa zlog: tsan+dan bing chen phrag la phyar: lha bdud rnams kyi g.yul ngo zlog: thod rlon 'bar ba'i do shal can: dur khrod ma mo'i chad pa zlog: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can: dregs pa rnams kyi chad pa zlog: zhing chen lpags pas stod g.yogs mdzad: srin po rnams kyi chad pa zlog: glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon: lha chen rnams kyi chad pa zlog: zhabs la sag l+h+wam yu ring gsol: ma rungs pa yi tshogs rnams zlog: g.yas pa bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs thams cad zlog: g.yon pa brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis: srid gsum dmod pa thams cad zlog: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: che btsan rnams kyi chad pa zlog: khrag zhag thal bas sku la byugs: sha za rnams kyi chad pa zlog: hūm̐: yum chen kro dhī shwa rī mas: mo rgyud dmod pa thams cad zlog: sku ni thal skya lta bu'i mdog: ro langs rnams kyi chad pa zlog: dbu skra zhol po rting par sleb: drang srong rnams kyi chad pa zlog: phyag g.yas sbrul zhags 'bar ba 'phen: klu gnyan rnams kyi gnod pa zlog: mar khu khrag chang zhal du gsol: dbul phongs sdug bsngal thams cad zlog: phyag rgya lnga yis sku la brgyan: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad zlog: re lde'i sham thabs mdzad pa yis: ma mo rnams kyi bka' chad zlog: yab la rol pa'i tshul du bzhugs: gsang ba spyod la bar chod zlog: hūm̐: sras mchog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs: pho rgyud rnams kyi chad pa zlog: gri gug 'bar ba g.yas na 'dzin: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: g.yon pas thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin: dgra bo mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: dar nag ber chen sku la gsol:

nag po stong gi dmod pa zlog: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrog: khro bo rnams kyi chad pa zlog: sag l+h+wam gsol nas 'dor thabs bsgrad: las mgon rnams kyi chad pa zlog: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na: khro bo chen po king ka ra: khro bo khro mo'i pho nya zlog: sku mdog mthing nag 'od du 'bar: ya bdud chad pa dgra la zlog: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: ma bdud rnams kyi chad pa zlog: phyag g.yas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: gri thabs dgra dang bgegs la zlog: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang gsol: khrag nad dgra dang bgegs la thongs: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs dgra bgegs mnan: dgra bgegs sbyor ba ngan pa zlog: gri thogs ging chen bcu gnyis kyis: ging chen dkar po'i dmod pa zlog: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na: gnod sbyin dmar po gtum rngam 'bar: gnod sbyin dmar po'i chad pa zlog: phyag g.yas gser gyi ral gri phyar: mtshon cha dbal gyi chad pa zlog: g.yon pas gser mdung dmar po phyar: dgra yi ru mtshon phyar ba zlog: bse rmog bse khrab sku la gsol: zhub chen las la 'gyed pa zlog: sag l+h+wam gsol nas 'dor stabs bzhengs: gyad chen rnams kyi chad pa zlog: bse gdong spu gri thod khrag 'dzin: srin mo rnams kyi gnod pa zlog: bse yi skyes bu rnam bzhi yis: skyes bu rnams kyi chad pa zlog: bse yi bu mo rnam bzhi yis: bse mo rnams kyi chad pa zlog: mi dmar shan pa bzhi bcu yis: shan pas gri thabs gtong ba zlog: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na: gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la: sku mdog dud kha 'od du 'bar: sde brgyad rnams kyi chad pa zlog: dbu dgu bya rog zhal dang bcu: gza' chen rnams kyi chad pa zlog: g.yas pas gri gug skyin thang 'beb: thog dang ser ba 'beb pa zlog: g.yon pas chu srin zhags pa 'phen: sa bdag rnams kyi chad pa zlog:

sku la mig stong sdang mig bsgrad: lha 'dre stong gi gnod pa zlog: sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing 'khyug: klu chen rnams kyi gnod pa zlog: gza' chen rgyu skar rnams kyis bskor: gza' skar dus tshes ngan pa zlog: gdong mo bzhi ni pho nyar 'gyed: gza' yi king kang 'beb pa zlog: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na: dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti: ma mo 'bum gyi pho nya zlog: sku mdog nag mo skem zhing sgeg: gshin rje mo yi chad pa zlog: dbu la rma bya'i thor tshugs can: gtsug phud can gyi chad pa zlog: zhal du mi ro rengs po gsol: ro za rnams kyi chad pa zlog: rna ba g.yas pa seng ges brgyan: rnam thos sras kyi gnod pa zlog: rna ba g.yon pa sbrul gyis brgyan: klu yi rgyal po'i gnod pa zlog: de la dril chung brgyan pa yis: lha phran rnams kyis gnod pa zlog: phyag g.yas khram shing 'bar ba 'dzin: gshin rje'i khram kha thams cad zlog: g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin: ma mo'i nad yams thams cad zlog: lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma 'char: sbyar dug dug nad thams cad zlog: de la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas: rlung mkhris bad kan nad rnams zlog: thod sbrul zhing gi pags pas brgyanaḥ dur khrod bdag po'i gnod pa zlog: glang chen ko rlon re lde gsol: dur khrod bdag mo'i gnod pa zlog: drel rta rkang gsum chibs su 'chib: mgyogs byed rnams kyi chad pa zlog: ma mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor: 'dre mo rnams kyi gnod pa zlog: hūm̐: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yis: dgra dang bgegs kyi gnod pa zlog: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad kyis: dmod pa'i mtshon cha thams cad zlog: bka' srung dregs pa sde brgyad kyis: snang srid lha 'dre'i gnod pa zlog: mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la bab: bh+yo: nam mkha' lha yi byad sna zlog:

bar snang gnyan gyi byad kha= sa gzhi klu yi byad gtad= gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba= ma mo'i nad rkyal phye ba= mgon po'i par bu bskor ba= me lha'i sreg blug byed pa= gshin rje'i khram la btab pa= bdud kyi zhags pa nag po= btsan gyi gri thabs gtong ba= ging gi smyo 'bog gtong ba= gza' yi king kang 'beb pa= sa bdag klu gnyan khros pa= gnod sbyin dal kha 'beb pa: 'gong po'i za kha zug pa= the'u rang sris la rku ba= sa la dur 'debs byed pa= gza' skar zhag rtsis 'debs pa= bdud kyis tshe la rku ba= 'dre yis bla la 'jab pa= srog la hur thums byed pa= nyin gyi ltas ngan thams cad= mtshan gyi rmi lam ngan pa= spyi chag sgos chag thams cad= yul chag grong chag thams cad= mi la na tsha byung ba= phyugs la god kha byung ba= zhing gi btsa' sad ser gsum= bse rag zas la rku ba= dus kyi g.yo 'khrug thams cad= mi mthun rkyen rnams thams cad kun: sdang ba dgra yi steng du zlog: gnod pa bgegs kyi steng du= za ba 'dre yi steng du= phung ba sri yi steng du zlog: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod:

zlog sngags drag tu bzlas la thal mo brdab bo: gsad pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: yab gcig mgon po nag po ni: dam can rnams kyi gtso bo yin: sras mchog nag po chen po ni: pho rgyud yongs kyi gtso bo yin: kro tī shwa rī re ma ti: mo rgyud yongs kyi gtso mo yin: ging dang gnod sbyin gza' bdud gsum: dregs pa rnams kyi gtso bo yin: lha srin sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: sha la dga' zhing khrag la dgyes: bstan pa gnyan po'i mel tshe mkhan: da res bstan la dgra byung bas: ma g.yel chos skyong dgra la chos: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo bsgral ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐: gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: zhal lce snang srid lha 'dres mdzod: bden rdzun chos skyong khyod kyis ltos: bdag gis dkon mchog dpang btsugs nas: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir: bla med sangs rgyas sgrub pa la: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bo 'dis: bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan cing: brngan pa'i zas dang nor 'jal kyang: shin tu 'khu zhing rtsod pa 'gyed: nyam chung ri dwags ltar bros nas: dben pa'i ri la bsgoms gyur kyang: dgra bos glags lta tshol du byung: yun ring bsgrubs shing bsnyen pa'i lha: khyod la mthu rtsal ci 'dug blta: nyes med bdag la mgon skyabs mdzod: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa dang: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad par byas: lha dang bla ma dmod pa dang: chos kyi yo byad 'phrog tu byung: khyod kyi mthu rtsal thogs med kyis: mngon spyod mdzad pa'i dus la bab: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po mthu rtsal can: dregs pa pho nya las la 'gyed: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo ni: ming dang byang bur byas pa 'di: srid gsum gang du gnas gyur kyang: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungs: zhags pa can gyis rke nas chings: lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdoms:

dril bu can gyis myos par gyis: las kyi rlung gi rta la skyon: sngon nas khrid la phyi nas ded: btson khang 'bar ba'i nang du chug: hūm̐: las kyi pho nya mthu rtsal can: dgra dang bgegs rnams skyob byed pa'i: lha dang srung ma gang yang rung: dam tshig nyams pa skyob byed de: rgyal ba'i bka' 'gal dam las 'das: lha yang bsgral ba'i 'os yin pas: rdzas ngan char pas brgyal bar gyis: hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig chen de: rnam par shes pa rten la phob: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par gyis: byad kyi drwa ba'i nang du chug: dug khrag 'bar bas myos par gyis: hūm̐: ma mo rnams kyang las la chos: kun kyang 'jigs tshul rngams stabs can: ral pa mda' tsam sha ra ra: thun rdzas phur bu phyag na 'dzin: kun kyang drel rta rkang gsum chibs: mtshe mda' drag po skar ltar 'phen: yungs dkar ser ba sha ra ra: dug gi thun rlangs thibs se thib: khrag nad dmar po char du 'beb: mtshon cha mang po skar ltar 'khrug: mda' rgod drag po thog ltar 'beb: rdo thun rbab rgod nyi li li: dgra bgegs lus srog gnyis la ya: hūm̐: las kyi mgon po mthu rtsal can: phyag na gri gug 'bar ba thogs: ye shes mtshon cha'i rno ngar gyis: dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du ya: dkar nag gnyis kyi mtshams su ya: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag phos: rnam shes rten dang da phrol cig: srog las dmar nag dus la bab: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po khyed rnams kyis: dgra bo bsad pa'i sha dang khrag: rus pa pags pa nang khrol bcas: bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod: ming yang med par brlags nas kyang: dmigs med klong du bsgral bar mdzod: 'phang ba'i dus su dmag la bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la mthu bo che: lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin cing: lha min tshogs rnam pham par mdzad: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: ma hā kā la sku bzhengs shig: ma la ya yi ri bo nas: sras mchog nag po sku bzhengs shig:

khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: kro dhī shwa rī sku bzhengs shig: mtshon cha 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: khro chen king kar sku bzhengs shig: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: gnod sbyin dmar nag sku bzhengs shig: ki li sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: gza' bdud chen po sku bzhengs shig: mu le khrag mtsho'i gzhal yas nas: dpal ldan lha mo sku bzhengs shig: 'jig rten dregs pa'i gnas mchog nas: dregs chen sngags bdag sku bzhengs shig: dregs pa sde brgyad dgra la chos: hūm̐: mgon po las la chas pa'i tshe: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: phyag na ru mtshon beng chen bsnams: rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta nag 'chib: nag po stong gi tshogs kyis bskor: srid pa'i rgyal mo dag dang sbyor: pho rgyud mo rgyud las la rgyug: mtshan ni srog bdud nag po zhes: sras mchog rta zhon jag par rgyug: kro tī shwa rī rlung ltar 'tshubs: ma mo drel zhon las la 'gyed: ging dang gnod sbyin gri thabs gtong: gza' mchog rgyal pos king kang 'beb: stong gsum thams cad g.yo zhing 'khrugs: nad dang dug gi na bun gtibs: 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: mtshon cha'i ser ba thog mda' 'phen: bh+yo: mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: bdud 'dul sprul pa'i beng chen ni: dkar po lha yi dmag tshogs 'bum: dngul gyi go khrab sku la gsol: dung rta dkar po 'og tu zhon: dkar po shel gyi ba dan 'dzin: lha dmag mang po sprin ltar gtibs: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la ya: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: ser po gnyan gyi dmag tshogs 'bum: gser gyi go khrab sku la gsol: gser rta ser po 'og tu zhon: ba dan ser po lhabs se lhab: gnyan dmag ser ltar sha ra ra: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la ya: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: dmar po btsan gyi dmag tshogs 'bum: zangs rmog zangs khrab sku la gsol: btsan rta dmar po 'og tu zhon:

ba dan dmar po me ltar 'bar: btsan dmag rbab ltar hri li li: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la ya: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: nag po bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'bum: bdud kyi go khrab sku la gsol: bdud rta nag po 'og tu zhon: ba dan nag po mun ltar gtibs: bdud dmag rlung ltar tshubs se tshub: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la ya: do nub gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: ging chen dge slong mdo 'don brgya: sngags pa nag po phur thogs brgya: bud med nag mo dul rdeb brgya: skyes pa dpa' bo stag chas brgya: ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag dang bcas: gza' bdud rgyal pos dmag sna drongs: king chen shan pa jag par rgyugs: lha mos dug mtshon dpon mo gyis: sras mchog nag pos jag dpon mdzod: kro tī shwa rīs bya ra mdzod: ma hā kā las rting nas non: bzlog med g.yul ngo chen po sprod: dgra bgegs phung thal nyid du thongs: hūm̐: nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mgon po'i sku gcig bzhugs pa ni: dbu dang phyag kyang grangs med de: sku ni srid gsum gtos dang mnyam: ru lu ru lu'i sgra chen sgrog: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdud: mthu rtsal khyod las che ba med: 'khor gyi sras mchog la sogs pa'i: ma mgon lcam dral dregs pa'i tshogs: mngon spyod drag po'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung: bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs rnams la: nad mtshon dug gi char phob la: mi sod khyim shigs nor phrogs la: thal ba rdul du brlag par gyis: zhes bskul zhing dul mo brdab la dmod mo bya'o: dgra bgegs sreg pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: dregs pa'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas: drag po zhal gyi hom khung du: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: lus dang longs spyod zhal du bstab: srid pa gsum gyi byad byed dang: sems kyi sbyor ba ngan pa dang: ngag gi smra ba ngan pa dang: lus las byung ba'i gdug rtsub rnams: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi:

mgul du sgrim mo ā ral+li: ming yang med par dz+wa la raṃ: zhes ming byang rnams me la bsreg go: mnan pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la'i bka' nyan pa: las kyi dregs pa mthu stobs can: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: khyod kyi za skal 'di kho na: gtad do gnyer ro ma shor cig: sa 'og rim pa dgu yi gnas: btson khang nag po'i nang du chug: nam yang gtang bar ma byed cig: bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma hā kā las bro brdungs pas: lha mo'i tshogs kyang dbyings su rol: dregs pa sde brgyad las la 'gyed: bya nag khyi nag sprin ltar gtibs: dug lngas gzir ba'i dgra dang bgegs: ye shes lnga yi rmang du mnan: sku ni gar dgus bro chen brdung: gsung ni hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro'i glu: thugs ni sgrol mdzad ye shes thugs: sku gsung thugs kyi bro brdungs pas: dug gsum dgra bgegs rdul du brlag: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de ltar las bcol pas phrin las thams cad mi 'grub mi srid do: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000230o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i gter ma'o/// /
